name: Sarivadi Vati

sections.reference_ayurveda_sara_sangraha: Sarivadi Vati is an Ayurvedic medicine available in the tablet form. It is used to treat hearing problems such as tinnitus, ear infection etc.
sections.ingredients:
Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Licorice – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Kushta – Saussurea lappa 
 Cinnamon – Cinnamomum verum 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Cardamom  – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Nagakesara – Mesua ferrea 
 Priyangu – Callicarpa macrophylla 
 Nilotpala – Nymphaea stellata 
 Guduchi  -Tinospora cordifolia 
 Clove – Syzigium aromaticum 
 Triphala – Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellirica, Emblica officinalis 
 Abhrak bhasma – Bhasma of Silica 
 Loha bhasma – Bhasma of purified and processed Iron 
 Bhringraj decoction – Eclipta alba 
  Arjuna – Terminalia arjuna 
 Java -Hibiscus rosa sinensis 
  Makoy – Solanum nigrum 
 Gunjamoola – Root of Abrus precatorius 

 Method of Preparation 
 Made the fine powder of ingredients from 1-12 by taking one gram of each. Then 14 grams of both Abhrak bhasma and Loha bhasma are also added. It is further processed with decoction of Bhringraj (Eclipta alba), Arjuna (Terminalia arjuna), Java (Hibiscus rosa sinensis), Makoy (Solanum nigrum) and Gunjamoola (Root of Abrus precatorius). Tablets of 375 mg are rolled. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sarivadi Vati is an amazing combination of natural ingredients which is used to manage various problems. Primarily this medicine is used to manage hearing problems such as tinnitus, ear infection etc. Antimicrobial action of this medicine fights against the bacterial infections in the ear. In diabetes, this helps to lower down the elevated blood sugar levels. It works well to manage the bleeding disorders like rectal bleeding, hemorrhage, epistaxis, menstrual disorders etc. Natural ingredients used in this formulation help to manage the heart and respiratory complications. Moreover cardiovascular properties of this medicine help to strengthen the heart muscles and maintain the proper blood flow in the body. Sarivadi Vati is known to be very effective to lower down the temperature in chronic fever. It is also a good medicine to manage the symptoms in epilepsy like seizures, fainting, temporary confusion etc.

sections.dosage: 1-2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food, or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor.
sections.side_effects:
This medicine should strictly be taken under medical supervision.

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
